89257: The main male protagonist of the series, the twin brother of Kiseki, and the hapless leader of the titular 35th Test Platoon more infamously known as the "Small Fry Platoon".
89258: A Relic Eater contracted to Takeru Kusanagi. Her true classification is that of a Sacred Treasure Type Magical Heritage, Mistelteinn who was previously wielded by one of Takeru's ancestors, Mikoto Kusanagi. Unlike other magical heritages, she prefers staying in her human form.
89259: A witch most famously known as the Witch of Aurora, based off her ancient Aurora attribute. She was formerly a conscript member of Valhalla before becoming the first enrolled witch in the Anti-Magic Academy where she joined the 35th Test Platoon.
89260: The primary female protagonist of the series. She was a former Dullahan of the Inquisition's EXE before her demotion had her sent back into the Anti-Magic Academy and assigned to the infamous 35th Test Platoon. She is contracted to Vlad.
89261: The 35th Platoon's prodigious sniper with a crippling case of stage fright. She hails from a high-class family with ties to the Inquisition's higher ups. Usagi is a simple girl with simple motivations to become a sanctioned Inquisitor.
89262: The 35th Platoon's technological expert and Takeru's oldest friend. Ikaruga is an extremely laid-back individual with habits that resemble a shut in.
150876: Kiseki is the younger twin sister of Takeru Kusanagi and is one of the last surviving members of the Kusanagi Clan.
150958: The captain of the 15th test platoon. He is the primary rival of Takeru Kusanagi, as well as being his acquaintance since middle school. He is contracted with Nero. Kyouya was born into a rough family whose upbringing molded his near-constant aggressive demeanor.
150959: The eccentric student council president of Anti-Magic Academy and had secretly aspired to become the next head of the Inquisition. She is the second leader of the Heretic Alliance. Nagaru is an extremely relaxed person who was generally amiable to everyone around her.
150960: The principal of Anti-Magic Academy as well as the Chairman and founder of the Inquisition. Sougetsu puts on the facade of an outgoing and carefree individual who leads the Inquisition with certain fervor and diligence.
150962: Valhalla's unruly rogue officer who seeks to sate his desire to spread despair and suffering rather than following through with the organization's actual goals. He wields the Magical Heritage blade, Dáinsleif. Haunted is an agent of chaos who only acts out his own self interest.
150963: A half wood-elf girl created by the Alchemists' Design Children, effectively making her Ikaruga Suginami's daughter. Believing her mother to be have been killed by the Inquisition, Kanaria joined Valhalla to fight against them to avenge her.
150967: Ikaruga's "twin" sister who was previously affiliated with the Alchemists before allying herself with Valhalla after promising them to revive the mythical dark elves.
150971: A member of the 15th Platoon and a childhood friend of its captain Kyouya. She aspired to become a Seelie in the Inquisition. Being the most passive and amiable among her platoon, Yoshimizu is known to be the peace-keeper for her rather belligerent captain's abrasive tendencies.
150972: Usagi's childhood acquaintance and fiance. He transferred to the Anti-Magic Academy and became its Ethics Committee Chairman while in leagues with Valhalla witch Mephistopheles. Due to the Temyouji Household's regal status, Reima is seen as a proud, gentle and kind person.
150973: The stern captain of the EXE and the Dullahans, effectively giving him the 2nd most influence in the Inquisition's troops after Sougetsu himself.
150975: A member of the EXE who was previously an ace sniper in the Banshees. She primarily worked under Hayato Kurogane before joining the Heretic Alliance. She is contracted with Nobunaga.
150976: An ancient member of the Kusanagi Clan, the blademaster of Takeru Kusanagi as well as one of the two leaders of Valhalla along with Mother Goose. He was the previous wielder of Lævateinn.
150977: The Relic Eater contracted Kyouya Kirigaya and is designated as Malleus Malificarum V. Her intrinsic abilities pertain to the use of a wide variety of poisons both in and out of combat.
150979: A Lost-Type Magical Heritage with a female personality whose physical form is that of the legendary blade, Dáinsleif. She is wielded by Haunted. In her regular form, Nacht takes the shape of a twisted rapier with a skull by its handle.
151821: A member of Valhalla whose primary power involved stealing and taking over bodies. She was a powerful witch whose unfortunate encounter with the Inquisition had her soul removed from her body, leaving it an empty but usable vessel.
151822: The Relic Eater under contract with Ouka Ootori and is designated as Malleus Malificarum IV. His intrinsic capabilities involve the usage of blood to dispel magic. He was previously utilized by Kazuma Mineshiro.
151824: The student council secretary. She serves as Nagaru's spy.
151825: Usagi's step mother and the current matriarch of the Sainoji Household. Due to Usagi's position as a illegitimate daughter from a mistress, Kikyou resented Usagi as she deemed as an outsider to the family and actively avoided being referred to as her mother.
153104: Usagi's curious older brother who accidentally died after he carelessly toyed with one his grandfather's guns, despite of Usagi's efforts to stop him.
153105: The leader of the Alchemists faction as well as the organization's CEO.
